context_diary: The account_lookup function retrieves user profiles via lookup_account with username as the primary identifier, supporting return_fields to specify which data points to fetch. Full profiles include core identity fields (id, username, email), classification metadata (type, status), operational settings (currency), and system flags (is_test_account, is_system_account). Timestamps track creation and modification history. The function returns structured JSON with status indicators and match counts, enabling precise single-record retrieval when username is known.
